title: Tokina 100-300mm f/5.6 Macro Zoom Lens w/ Tiffen 55mm UV Filter - Manual Focus
descriptionText:
Capture stunning telephoto shots with this vintage Tokina 100-300mm f/5.6 Macro Zoom Lens. This versatile manual focus lens is ideal for wildlife, sports, and portrait photography. It also features macro functionality (1:4 ratio) for close-up detail shots. Comes with a Tiffen 55mm UV filter installed to protect the front element.

Features:

Focal Length: 100-300mm
Maximum Aperture: f/5.6
Minimum Aperture: f/32
Macro Capability: 1:4
Manual Focus
Comes with: Tokina front lens cap + Tiffen 55mm UV Protector Filter

Condition:
Lens optics are [clear / show minor dust – adjust as needed]
Aperture blades move smoothly and are free of oil
Zoom and focus rings turn smoothly
Exterior shows [light signs of wear / minor scuffing – adjust as needed]

Please Note: This is a vintage, manual lens and will not autofocus on modern DSLR or mirrorless cameras unless adapted.
